responsibility: Provides the small-storage-optimized collection API for `rustc_data_structures` by exposing `SsoHashMap` and `SsoHashSet`: `map.rs` implements the core hash map that stores entries inline for small sizes and transparently switches to an `FxHashMap` when needed, `set.rs` adapts that map into a set interface, `either_iter.rs` supplies the unified iterator adapter that lets these collections present one iterator type across their inline and heap-backed representations, and `mod.rs` ties these pieces together as the module’s public API surface.
